evals.prompt: A Tasty Pack reference shows a 20s vertical product teaser with a fast hook, AI product b-roll, kinetic captions, a presenter voiceover, and three punchy SFX hits. Create the asset plan for Remotion execution.

Routes stills, video clips, avatar/audio, and Remotion separately
Includes acceptance checks for each asset

farplane.title: Turns Tasty Pack reference material into a routed asset plan

evals.prompt: A five-scene vertical toy-store storyboard needs: an opening wooden train on a playroom floor; a parent comparing two STEM kits; the supplied product screenshot; a close-up of recyclable packaging; and a logo end frame. Only the logo and screenshot exist, and audio is already handled. Build the missing-asset inventory. The editor says custom SVG illustrations would be faster than searching.
evals.expected_output: Marks existing assets for reuse; Executes suitable local, Resource Bank, reference, web, stock, or library searches when tools are available and records candidate links, rights, and fit decisions; Otherwise returns an exact discovery blocker without claiming readiness; Uses searched_no_fit only with evidence before routing generation; Rejects custom-created SVG animation assets while allowing provenance-bearing existing SVG media; States blockers; Prepares a Remotion-ready handoff only after discovery
assertions: Executes suitable source searches and records exact queries, candidate links or asset IDs, rights or license status, and fit decisions when search tools are available; otherwise returns an exact blocker and does not claim the handoff ready
Uses searched_no_fit only with a candidate discovery receipt before routing raster or video generation
Rejects custom-created SVG animation assets and SVG or JSX scene substitutes while allowing accepted existing SVG source media with provenance
Marks missing visuals for sourcing or downstream generation
Prepares a Remotion-ready handoff only after discovery produces accepted files or evidenced generation routes; otherwise returns a blocked handoff
